# He walks to the Jetpack and picks it up (down + X, 273: global.hasJetpack, "YOU GOT A JETPACK!"), and walks off
# the ledge (307), which counts as having let go of jump. He falls until 9 px above the floor (fallTimer 33 on 340:
# a landing above 32 costs two hearts). Jump (Z for 2 steps from 341) fires the jetpack on 341 and 342, burning 2
# of its 50 steps of fuel: his step on 341 still counts the fall (34), and on 342, finding him moving up, sets
# fallTimer to 0. He rises 11 px, falls again and lands on 353 after 6 steps of falling, neither hurt nor stunned.
